Title: Launcher / PC features
Shot: Opens your installed Companion launcher. Move slowly through Display (Picture, Scaling), Input and the Controls window, Cheats and Mods, Soundtrack and Achievements; open the Update window to show it, then close it. 3-5 s per page. Do not press Apply, Play or Update.
Caption: The Companion Launcher: picture, scaling, controls, mods, soundtrack and updates in one place.
Settings: Your installed launcher as it is (not a private copy): leave every setting unchanged.

Title: Edward Castle rampart / wide view
Shot: Will stands on the castle rampart under the mountain sky. Wait 3 s for the room title to fade, then walk slowly left to the guard and back right to the wall, 20-30 s. No fighting here.
Caption: True widescreen drawn from the game's own scenery: Edward Castle, with the Japanese release's sky (GaiaLabs option).
Settings: Standard set: Wide view, HD scaling (smooth), HD Mode 7, MSU-1 music, status display at the edges, cheats off. GaiaLabs JP Edward Castle background on (default). Checkpoint: a new game with no story flags, warped here with a new game's stats; one flag: $3F (the gate guard has already seen the letter; otherwise the intrusion scene plays).

Title: Great Wall / wide view
Shot: Will stands a few steps from the west end of the wall walk. Walk right past the gatehouse and along the rampart under the desert sky, 20-30 s; hold A (run) for a stretch.
Caption: The Great Wall stretching across the wide view, with the Japanese release's background (GaiaLabs option).
Settings: Standard set. GaiaLabs JP Great Wall background on (default). Checkpoint: a new game with no story flags, warped here with life 40 and STR/DEF 99 (with a new game's 8 life and no defence, enemies in the Diamond Mine and Mu ended a take within seconds).

Title: Dark Space / Will becomes Freedan

Title: Retranslated text / hold to advance
Shot: Will arrives at the right end of the Great Wall and his narration opens at once. Hold X: hold to advance turns each page at reading speed; let go and tap X for single pages, 20-30 s.
Caption: The GaiaLabs Retranslation is built in: 1,133 retranslated dialogue entries, menus and room titles. Hold a button to advance text.
Settings: Standard set. Hold to advance on at Normal pace (instead of Fast) so each page can be read; text speed Normal. Checkpoint: a new game with no story flags, warped here with a new game's stats; the narration's flag $9D is clear on purpose so it plays.

Title: Area map and radar
Shot: Walk a few steps so the radar in the corner shows, then press Enter (Start) for the area map: C / V zoom, wait 3 s, Z to return. Walk into the courtyard and open it again, 20-30 s.
Caption: Area map (Start): a map of the scenery that fills in as you explore, with exits and chests, and a small radar while you play.
Settings: Standard set + radar ON. The explored-area records are a private copy of your own (read only), so the map is already partly revealed. Checkpoint: the Angkor Wat one from scene 07.

Title: Save states / browser and rewind
Shot: Walk around Mu for 10 s. Press F12 and rewind a few seconds, then resume. Press F11: the browser shows this session's six states (other scenes' places); move through them, load one (confirm), 30-40 s. Shift+F2 saves; F1 returns to the start (asks first).
Caption: Save states with a browser and pictures (F11), and rewind (F12); loading and overwriting ask first.
Settings: Standard set. Six private states: slot 1 is this scene, slots 2-6 are the castle, Great Wall, Sky Garden, Diamond Mine and Babel checkpoints. Checkpoint: the Mu one from scene 08.

Caption: Optional status display at the screen edges in the wide view: player life at the left, DP centred, enemy life at the right.
Settings: Standard set, but the status display at the edges starts OFF (you switch it on in the in-game settings). Checkpoint: the Diamond Mine one from scene 06.

Title: Achievement / Behind the Hedge
Shot: Will stands below Freejia's hedges. Walk Up into the hedge while tapping X until the hidden man speaks; advance his lines with X. The achievement notice appears; keep recording 5 s. Then Esc > Achievements to show it unlocked, 30 s.
Caption: Achievements, saved on your PC: a secret unlocks with an in-game notice.
Settings: Standard set, no cheats, so achievements record. They go to this session's own folder: a throwaway profile, never your real progress. Checkpoint: a new game with no story flags, warped here with a new game's stats; one flag: $64 (Freejia arrival scene done); the secret's own flag $E1 is clear.
